name: SENTIENT
summary: The on-chain half of an autonomous risk engine: signed, bounded regime signals that can only restrict routed flow.
behavior: An off-chain engine submits an Ed25519-signed StrategySignal; the program checks signer, nonce, freshness and the market-set TTL ceiling.
Regimes: NORMAL, CAUTIOUS, DEFENSIVE (routed trades above the configured cap are denied) and CIRCUIT_BREAKER (routed trades are denied until the regime expires).
Records routed buy and sell flow that the engine reads back.
verification: source in this repository; reproducible-build verification not yet published
limitations: The engine never signs for users, never trades and never moves funds; signals can only restrict routed trades.
Every signal expires; a regime lasts at most the market-set TTL (≤ 24 h).
